recipe.title: Cheese puffs
recipe.notes: This is Mum's recipe, which I used to make with her when I was a kid.

method.s: Sift dry ingredients together. Add cheese and mix.
Pour in milk, then quickly stir into a moist dough.
Put large spoonfuls into greased muffin tins.
Bake at 230 deg C for around 10 minutes.
